text:
alyssa_cs: FYI Nebula AI pinged — they want to onboard a private 13B summarizer and require HSM for key management. said they have PHI in some docs so we need a strict data flow and eval plan.
jorge_se: thanks — do we know expected QPS and latency SLO? also are they asking for Dedicated or Private (VPC/on-prem)?
alyssa_cs: customer prefers Private VPC, possibly air-gapped later. initial traffic low: ~3 rps peak but 99p latency target <350ms for short docs. noted renewal is tied to cost vs accuracy — high sensitivity.
sam_engineer: 13B with HSM + VPC — we should ask about batching tolerance and max seq len. quantized int8/4 viable? GPU type request?
alyssa_cs: they said batch size should be <=4, seq len ~1024. prefer A10G-ish perf but willing to test lower-tier. they flagged hallucination on medical cases — safety evals needed.
jorge_se: plan: request test corpus (50-100 de-identified clinical summaries), run safety/eval suite (toxicity, hallucination recall, PHI leakage tests), then perf run on dedicated infra. Can we get an API key for preprod sandbox?
mika_prod: I'll own enablement — need docs + runbook for their SREs, and a 60min onboarding session. Also capture renewal risk in CRM (customer tier: mid-market; renewal sensitive).
ops_bot: new ticket created CS-7889: Nebula AI private model intake. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-7889
sam_engineer: For evals: suggest these steps
```
1) static evals: rouge/bertscore on clinical prompts
2) safety tests: prompt injection, hallucination probes, red-team pairs
3) privacy checks: PHI detection + tokenization leakage tests
4) perf: p99 latency at batch=1..4, memory footprint, kv-cache behavior
```
jorge_se: add quantization matrix doc and target perf baselines. if they require HSM for keys we need security signoff and a short SLA note.
alyssa_cs: asked Nebula to upload sample corpus + data handling form. told them we need CI logs and acceptance criteria by EOD Fri. they agreed to a short pilot window of 2 weeks.
mika_prod: scheduled onboarding call Thu 10am PT, invited eng + se + customer. I'll prepare a one-pager (playbook) + demo script.
sam_engineer: I'll spin up a preprod cluster w/ 1xA10G and quantized 13B to run initial perf by Wed. tagging Jorge for rollout config.
jorge_se: noted — I'll draft rollout policy: canary->50%->100%, automatic fallback to smaller 7B if latency/regressions. will include traffic shaping and alert thresholds.
alyssa_cs: capture action items in CS-7889: ask for corpus, DM me contact at Nebula, confirm VPC peering timeline, legal for HSM. Also flag renewal risk: attach renewal note to account (attenuated if pilot meets p99 SLA and hallucination threshold). :spiral_note_pad:
mika_prod: got it. will share playbook before Tue.
ops_bot: CS-7889 updated with checklist items.
alyssa_cs: thanks team — I'll follow up after onboarding call and close loop with customer.
